# Translate

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Moves native painted content without changing its original flow box.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IContentContainer`, `IStatefulElement`.

```csharp
new Translate()
```

- [`Child`](#child): The native subtree to transform.
- [`ContentWidth`](#contentwidth): Optional positive child width before transformation, in points.
- [`X`](#x): Signed horizontal paint offset; positive moves right.
- [`Y`](#y): Signed vertical paint offset; positive moves down.
